name: Bapst Berry Patch
tagline: Growing strawberries for two decades at Bapst Berry Patch – Ohio Ag Net
description: A working berry farm in Beaver, OH, Bapst Berry Patch grows Strawberries. The farm is busiest in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
